newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Sanctuary Housing mortgage debenture.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Sanctuary Housing mortgage debenture.

text.p: Standard & Poors said it had assigned Sanctuary Housing Association's 60 million stg first mortgage debenture stocks due 2031, a long-term credit rating of AA minus.
"The rating reflects the strong cash flow generating characteristics of the charged portfolio of social housing properties," S&P said in a statement received on Monday.

"The rating also takes into account the potential variability in future rental income and stock maintenance costs, and a general exposure to future social housing policy and property market developments."
S&P said the rating recognised a number of risks including the need for a minimal level of rental inflation.
"Housing association rents have increased at a significantly higher level than inflation since 1989 and have also oustripped increases in average housing association tenant income," the agency said.

"However, the current rent levels of the charged properties fall significantly below both market rent levels and the rent ceiling established by housing benefit, an important rent subsidy that tenants receive directly from the British government," S&P said.
"This provides reassurance as to the flexibility available to further raise rents on the charged properties."
